title: crepis setosa subsp. typica
intro: Crepis setosa subsp. typica, commonly known as the lesser hawk's beard, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Crepis setosa subsp. typica include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit hepatoprotective properties, and display potential anti-cancer and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, particularly helenalin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
